Tirupati,
Date:     -09-2024.
From
P. Murali Krishna
General Manager(Procurement),
T TDevasthanams,
Tirupati.

To 
The Station House Officer 
East  Police Station
Tirupati 

Subject: TTD – Supply of Ghee by A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul – Adulterated - Report received from NDDB CALF - Request to take necessary Criminal action – Regarding.
						*****
There were several complaints from the pilgrims on the quality of Laddu prasadams. The cow ghee procurement process and the quality issues were reviewed in depth and noticed that there were several issues affecting the quality of Laddu prasadams. 
Suppliers were supplying poor quality ghee which lacks aroma and taste, which was possibly adulterated. TTD has warned all the existing suppliers to improve the quality of ghee supplied and warned that sub-standard stocks will be tested in outside Labs for adulteration and the firm will be blacklisted with the suitable penalties if the tests indicate adulteration.
Taking into consideration of the warning given by TTD, all the firms improved their quality of ghee except one supplier i.e, M/s A R Dairy Foods pvt Ltd., Dindigal, Tamilnadu.
I am to inform that Supply orders were issued to M/s A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul duly following the tender procedure for supply of 10,00,000 Kgs of Cow Ghee with Agmark Special Grade with certain terms and conditions.  
A e-tender was floated on 12.03.2024 for supply of 10 Lakh Kgs of Cow Ghee within 1500 kms of radius from Tirumala. The tender was finalised on 08.05.2024 and supply order was issued on 15.05.2024.Prima facie his price of Rs 319.80 appeared to be unviable and unreasonable for supplying pure Ghee.
M/s A R Dairy supplied four(4) tankers on 12.06.2024, 20.06.2024, 25.06.2024 and 04.07.2024 respectively which were accepted with the earlier procedure of testing which doesn’t include adulteration testing. After thisa decision was taken to use the services of outside NABL accredited Lab for adulteration testing by tying up with NDDB, CALF Lab, Anand for enforcing Quality as per tender conditions. This was the first time that such system of testing Ghee for adulteration was done in TTD. Accordingly samples from Four (4) tankers which were supplied on 06.07.2024 (2 tankers)&12.07.2024 (2 tankers) were collected on 06.07.2024 & 12.07.2024 and sent to NDDB CALF Ltd., Anand, Gujarat confidentially for testing its quality.
The reports were received on 16.07.2024 and 23.07.2024. In the analysis reports issued by NDDB CALF Ltd., TTD noticed that there is high level of adulteration of the Ghee supplied.
As per the report of NDDB, it is concluded that all the samples have vegetable and animal fat based adulterants including LARD. In this regard, Show Cause Noticeswere issued to M/s A R dairy Food Pvt Ltd., on  22.07.2024, 23.07.2024 & 27.07.2024 and a rejoinder notice Dt. 28.08.2024 was issued.  The said company has sent reply letter dt. 28.07.2024 and 04.09.2024 to the Show Cause notice, denying the allegation made against A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul.
In this connection, I am complaining to express my concerns regarding the adulteration of ghee supplied by A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul.TTD purchases Ghee for preparation of Swamivari Laddu and other prasadams as per Dittam.  We expect values, quality and authenticity and we were disheartened to discover that the ghee supplied by A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul, recently did not meet the expected standards.
Ghee is an essential part for preparation of Swamivari Laddu and other Prasadams as per Dittam and its quality directly affects both health, religious sentiments and beliefs of crores of devotees of Lord Sri Venkateswara.  Adulterated ghee not only compromises taste, but can also poseserious health risks to devotees. We were made to believe that A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigulhas been maintaining strict quality control measures to ensure that their products meet safety and quality standards; but, the sample results were otherwise.
The NDDB CALF Ltd., Gujarat has sent their report Dt. 12.07.2024 and as per the Lab report the S Value for sample is as given below.

Condition No.47:The supplied material should be without adulteration. If adulteration is noticed in the material supplied, the supplier will be prosecuted besides blacklisting the firm and forfeiting the Earnest Money Deposit and Security Deposit. The TTD also reserves the right to levy an additional Composite penalty at 5% (maximum) on the total value of the material supplied to TTD by the supplier in case of whatsoever quality problems encountered by TTD in supply of the material.”
Condition No.49:For breach of any of the above tender conditions, the E.M.D. and Security Deposit are liable to be forfeited duly blacklisting the Firm. Further, Non-performance of any of the contract provisions to the satisfaction of TTD will disqualify the supplier to participate in the tenders for the next five years, by disabling the digital certificate.”
Condition No.65:The impermissible variations with reference to the specifications on Lab testing will be viewed seriously and will lead to BLACKLISTING.”
Condition No.74:The supplier shall meet the standards / specifications of Cow ghee stipulated by TTD and FSSR, which are Mandatory and Agmark Special grade”.
Condition No.76:The Analytical report for ghee given by the Food and Water Laboratory of TTD (in house) and /or the report given by an outsourced laboratory to which TTD sends the samples, is binding on the supplier.  Non-compliance with respect to TTD, FSSR and Agmark special grade specifications will attract action as per the tender conditions of TTD.
A R Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigulhad violated the abovementioned agreement clauses and committed Cheating by adulterating Ghee. The A,R,Dairy Food pvt. Ltd quoted lowest price for Cow ghee and thereby induced the TTD to get the order for 10 lakhs kgs of Ghee with them. The A.R. Dairy Food Pvt Ltd by supplying substandard and adulterated ghee to have wrongful gain, deceived the TTD and the devotees.      The supplier also committed Breach of Trust due to failure of supply of pure cow ghee by violating the promise made by him as per Agreement terms and conditions.  He has also committed offences pertaining to food adulteration as defined under IPC.  The Adulteration of Ghee is nothing but a criminal conspiracy between the supplier and some vested interests, whose names are to be brought to book by conducting thorough investigation. The News of supplying adulterated ghee for the preparation of Laddu prasadam was spread all over India through electronic media, leading to lots of protest by the people whose belief was affected. There are lots of debate and dialogue war between different groups in the media which is likely to disturb the public tranquillity. 
Gheewas supplied by the supplier without observing safety standards and liability of the manufacturer.Hence, by supplying adulterated ghee he violated the penal sections 51 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Hence, it is requested to register this complaint and issue FIR and conduct thorough investigation to find out true facts regarding adulteration of Ghee which brought disrepute to the name and fame of the TTD and also seriously effecting religious sentiments of crores of devotees of Lord Venkateswara and you are requested to take stringent legal action against the culprits.
Enclosures:
Supply order issued to M/s A R Food Private Limited, Dindigul Dt.15.05.2024
NDDB CALF Test Report Dt. 12.07.2024 &16.07.2024

In the Service of Lord Venkateswara 
							
P. Murali Krishna
